comment: Accepted exceptions of tools/check-design-rules.mjs. One entry names one file and one rule, and it states why the rule cannot hold there. Do not add an entry to make a new screen pass.

allow.reason: The preview cards of Mode and Theme paint token values that they read from the theme registry at run time, one set per family and mode. A utility class names a value at build time, so it cannot express a colour that the registry chooses.
The sandboxed diagram frame writes the SVG that the isolated Mermaid renderer produced. The frame runs on a sandboxed origin, so the markup never reaches the application origin. Decision record 0013.

The build writes the one built stylesheet of the application into the sandboxed diagram frame, because the frame has an opaque origin and cannot load a file of the origin. The element holds the output of apps/web/src/tailwind.css and no style of its own. Records 0061 and 0158.

The box of the checkbox recipe is one of the five controls that decision 0063 reserves the component edge for. A person reads the state of a checkbox from its shape alone, so its edge must meet the 3 to 1 non text minimum that theme.test.ts holds `border` to.
The drop target of the folder tree is named by decision 0063. While a row is dragged over a folder, the edge is the whole message, so it must meet the 3 to 1 non text minimum.

The mathematics widget writes the markup that `renderMath` in @notesapp/markdown returned, which strips every element and every attribute outside the KaTeX drawing set first. The editor builds its own DOM, so no React node can carry that markup.
Tree indentation comes from the current folder depth and the shared indent token. The tree has no fixed depth limit, so a finite set of utility classes cannot state every level.
